## What tier 1 verified

301 tests, 15 failed, 286 passed — in tier1-image, at 2026-08-10T08:42:40Z.

Tier 1 flies SITL's own generic frames. It verifies that the right procedure is chosen for an airframe, that acceptance criteria are evaluated against measured state, that the server and the page work in a browser, and that a complete run directory comes out.

**It verifies nothing about any model above.** That is why a model tier 2 has not flown stays `untested` no matter how green tier 1 is.
